Three parts: (1) up to 100% extra risk cover for insured consignments 14 Feb–15 Mar 2026; (2) up to 95% cover for consignments 16 Mar–15 Jun 2026; (3) up to 50% reimbursement (max ₹50 lakh) for non-insured MSME exporters
MAR-064.text: ★ RELIEF: export support amid West Asia disruptions In plain words:  With shipping and insurance costs shooting up because of the West Asia war, the government is covering exporters' extra risk through ECGC.
